lessons.key: ac_gap::every validation ac must ship with an http level or unit assertion for invalid field formats not only happy path updates
lessons.text: Todo critério de aceite de validação deve nascer com assertion HTTP ou unit para formatos inválidos de campo, não só happy path.

lessons.key: ac_gap::route e2e suites must assert the global auth boundary with an unauthenticated request when the feature is behind authguard
lessons.text: Suites e2e de rota devem assertar a fronteira global de auth com request sem token quando a feature está atrás do AuthGuard.

lessons.key: ac_gap::translate prisma record not found p2025 on update into notfoundexception and cover it with a service test
lessons.text: Traduzir Prisma record-not-found (P2025) no update para NotFoundException e cobrir com teste de service.
